newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bond spreads narrow, curve steepens.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bond spreads narrow, curve steepens.

text.p: Australian bond spreads remain well supported to other dollar-bloc bonds as renewed talk of a local rate cut pushed bond prices higher on the day.

The rate cut case was strengthened by Wednesday's data confirming inflation was low and under control, and the talk is expected to keep the market well supported ahead of next week's Reserve Bank board meeting and fourth quarter wages data, and so spreads should also be supported, traders said.
However, spreads may also have trouble narrowing further, especially to Treasuries, they said.
Spreads to U.S. 10-year bonds appear to have settled into a 75-85 point range, while short bonds have run into resistance at around 40 basis points.
The yield curve continued its steepening trend of recent days, closing at its steepest in two weeks.
With the short end expected to be best supported by the expectations of a rate cut, the long end is most susceptible to any bearish sentiment in the U.S. markets.
